definitions.explanation: Formal reading of {明日|あした}, used in business correspondence, news, public announcements, and other formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {明日|みょうにち}{伺|うかが}います。
{明日|みょうにち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十時|じゅうじ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧です。
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting is from ten o'clock.

examples.japanese: {明日|みょうにち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{臨時|りんじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}→臨時休業：17041_rinjikyuugyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Tomorrow we will be temporarily closed.

notes:
The same kanji {明日} has three readings: あした (everyday), あす (slightly more formal but still common), and みょうにち (formal/literary). Use みょうにち in business letters, formal speech, and announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明日|みょうにち}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: from tomorrow (formal announcements)
- {明日|みょうにち}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by the end of tomorrow
- {明日|みょうにち}⟦{以降|いこう}→以降：03999_ikou⟧: from tomorrow onward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {明日|あした}: tomorrow — everyday spoken form
- {明日|あす}: tomorrow — slightly formal, common in news and writing
- {明日|みょうにち}: tomorrow — formal/business, rarely used in casual speech
